221	section PointRankPullback
222	
223	variable {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (G : X.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
224	
225	/-- **The point rank of a pullback module is the point rank at the image
226	point** (no flatness or finiteness hypotheses; the geometric form of
227	`Ideal.fiberRank_baseChange`): for any morphism `g : Y ⟶ X` and
228	quasi-coherent `G` on `X`,
229	`pointRank (g^*G) y = pointRank G (g y)`. -/
230	theorem pointRank_pullback (y : Y) :
231	    haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom g G ‹_›
232	    pointRank Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G) y = pointRank X G (g y) := by
233	  haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom g G ‹_›
234	  -- affine charts around the image point and the point
235	  obtain ⟨V, hV, hgyV, -⟩ :=
236	    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := g y) (U := ⊤) trivial
237	  have hyV : y ∈ g ⁻¹ᵁ V := hgyV
238	  obtain ⟨W, hW, hyW, hWle⟩ :=
239	    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := y) (U := g ⁻¹ᵁ V) hyV
240	  -- both sides through the two charts
241	  rw [pointRank_eq_chartFiberRank _ (V := ⟨W, hW⟩) y hyW,
242	    pointRank_eq_chartFiberRank G (V := ⟨V, hV⟩) (g y) hgyV]
243	  -- the section formula for the pullback module over the affine pair
244	  letI : Algebra Γ(X, V) Γ(Y, W) := (g.appLE V W hWle).hom.toAlgebra
245	  letI : Module Γ(X, V) Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G, W) :=
246	    Module.compHom _ (g.appLE V W hWle).hom
247	  obtain ⟨⟨eqv, -⟩⟩ :=
248	    pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_sectionLinearEquiv g G hW hV hWle
249	  -- fiber rank through the equivalence, then base change
250	  have h1 : ((hW.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyW⟩).asIdeal).fiberRank
251	      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G, W) =
252	      ((hW.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyW⟩).asIdeal).fiberRank
253	        (TensorProduct Γ(X, V) Γ(Y, W) Γ(G, V)) :=
254	    Ideal.fiberRank_congr _ eqv.symm
255	  have h2 := Ideal.fiberRank_baseChange (R := Γ(X, V)) (A := Γ(Y, W))
256	    Γ(G, V) ((hW.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyW⟩).asIdeal)
257	  -- identify the contracted prime with the prime of the image point
258	  have h3 : ((hW.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyW⟩).asIdeal).comap
259	      (algebraMap Γ(X, V) Γ(Y, W)) =
260	      (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨g y, hgyV⟩).asIdeal := by
261	    have h4 := IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE (f := g)
262	      V hV W hW hWle hyW
263	    have h5 : algebraMap Γ(X, V) Γ(Y, W) = (g.appLE V W hWle).hom := rfl
264	    rw [h5]
265	    exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal h4
266	  change ((hW.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyW⟩).asIdeal).fiberRank
267	      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G, W) =
268	    ((hV.primeIdealOf ⟨g y, hgyV⟩).asIdeal).fiberRank Γ(G, V)
269	  rw [h1, h2]
270	  exact Ideal.fiberRank_congr_ideal h3
271	
272	end PointRankPullback

733	/-- A **family of relative effective divisors on `X ×_S T / T`** (Kleiman §3

735	a `T`-flat, finitely presented quotient `q` of the structure sheaf of the
736	relative product `X_T = X ×_S T` with proper support, whose kernel ideal
737	`I = ker q` is invertible (`Scheme.LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial`).  The
738	associated divisor is the schematic support `D` of `F = O_{X_T}/I = O_D`;
739	conversely a relative effective divisor `D ⊆ X_T` yields the family
740	`q : O_{X_T} ↠ O_D`.

742	The source of `q` is stated as the pullback of the unit module `O_X` along
743	the first projection — canonically isomorphic to `O_{X_T}` — verbatim the
744	`E`-slot of `Scheme.QuotFamily` at `E = O_X`, so the Quot-family base-change

748	structure DivFamily (π : X ⟶ S) (T : Over S) : Type (u + 1) where

750	  relative product `X ×_S T`. -/

756	  divisor (Kleiman §3 Def. `df:red`). -/

759	  (automatic when `π` is proper; kept to match the Quot-family shape). -/
760	  properSupport : Modules.HasProperSupport (pullback.snd π T.hom) F

762	  unit, as in `QuotFamily` with `E = O_X`). -/
763	  q : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj

765	  /-- The quotient map is an epimorphism. -/
766	  epi : Epi q
767	  /-- **The divisor condition** (Kleiman §3 Def. `df:red`): the kernel ideal

778	closed subscheme (same convention as `QuotFamily.Rel`). -/
779	def Rel {T : Over S} (x y : DivFamily π T) : Prop :=
780	  ∃ f : x.F ≅ y.F, x.q ≫ f.hom = y.q
781

783	  ⟨Iso.refl _, Category.comp_id _⟩

786	  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h
787	  exact ⟨f.symm, by rw [Iso.symm_hom, Iso.comp_inv_eq]; exact hf.symm⟩
788	
789	lemma rel_trans {T : Over S} {x y z : DivFamily π T}
790	    (h1 : x.Rel y) (h2 : y.Rel z) : x.Rel z := by
791	  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h1; obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := h2
792	  exact ⟨f ≪≫ g,
793	    (congrArg (x.q ≫ ·) (Iso.trans_hom f g)).trans <|
794	      (Category.assoc x.q f.hom g.hom).symm.trans <|
795	        (congrArg (· ≫ g.hom) hf).trans hg⟩
796

798	instance setoid (π : X ⟶ S) (T : Over S) : Setoid (DivFamily π T) where

800	  iseqv := ⟨rel_refl, rel_symm, rel_trans⟩

802	/-- The **pullback action** on a family of divisors along `ψ : T' ⟶ T` of
803	`Over S`: pull the sheaf and the quotient map back along
804	`quotBaseMap π ψ : X_{T'} ⟶ X_T`, matching the `O`-side through
805	`pullbackTriangleIso (quotBaseMap_fst π ψ)` — exactly
806	`QuotFamily.pullbackAlong` at `E = O_X`.  The divisor condition base-changes
807	by `Modules.pullback_kernel_isLocallyTrivial`
808	(`lem:relative_divisor_base_change`). -/
809	noncomputable def pullbackAlong {T T' : Over S} (ψ : T' ⟶ T)
810	    (x : DivFamily π T) : DivFamily π T' where
811	  F := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (quotBaseMap π ψ)).obj x.F
812	  isFinitePresentation :=

# Upper semicontinuity of the point rank, without flatness

**Campaign milestone B5, base-side half.**  For a finitely presented
quasi-coherent module `F` on a locally noetherian scheme `S`, the sublevel
locus of the fibre dimension

```
{s : S | pointRank S F s ≤ e}
```

is **open**, with no flatness hypothesis anywhere.

## Why this is not the existing statement

`Picard/FlatteningStratificationUniversal.lean` already carries
`Scheme.Modules.isOpen_pointRank_pullback_eq`, and the two must not be
conflated:

* that theorem needs `Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 T)` on the pullback and
  concludes that the locus where the rank *equals* `e` is open — it is local
  constancy of the rank of a *flat* finitely presented module, geometrized;
* this one has **no flatness hypothesis** and concludes openness of the
  `≤ e` sublevel set.  Without flatness the rank genuinely jumps, so the
  equality loci are *not* open and only the sublevel direction survives.
  That is exactly the semicontinuity B5 asks for.

Neither implies the other: drop flatness from the first and it is false;
strengthen `≤ e` to `= e` here and it is false.

## The proof, and what it consumes

The locus is exactly the union `⋃ i ≤ e, chartLocus F i`, and
`Scheme.Modules.chartLocus` is by construction an `S.Opens` (a supremum of
affine opens), so openness is structural rather than earned:

* `⊆` is the **Nakayama prolongation**
  `Scheme.Modules.exists_presentationChart_mem`, packaged as
  `Scheme.Modules.mem_chartLocus_of_pointRank_eq`: a point of fibre dimension
  `i` has an affine neighbourhood carrying an `i`-generator matrix
  presentation.  Applied at `i := pointRank S F s`, which is `≤ e` by
  hypothesis;
* `⊇` is `Scheme.Modules.pointRank_le_of_mem_chartLocus` (an `i`-generator
  presentation bounds every fibre dimension in its chart by `i`), composed
  with `i ≤ e`.

So the mathematical content was already in the tree; what was missing was the
observation that the *union over `i ≤ e`* is the sublevel set.  No
monotonicity of `IsPresentationChart` in the generator count is needed — a
point contributes at its own rank, not at `e`.

## Scope, stated exactly

This is the **base-side** half of B5.  It is a statement about a module on
`S` and its fibre dimensions, and it is unconditional in the sense that
matters: no flatness, no `h¹`-vanishing, no properness.

It is **not** by itself `Scheme.HasH0Semicontinuity`
(`Picard/SemicontinuityH0.lean`), whose `h⁰` is the dimension of the global
sections of `L` on the scheme-theoretic *fibre curve* `C_t`, not the fibre
dimension of a module on the base.  Bridging the two needs the pushforward
`q_* L` to be finitely presented on the base and its fibre dimension to agree
with `q.fiberH0 L t` — and the landed bridge for that agreement,
`AlgebraicGeometry.rank_pushforward_eq_fiberH0`
(`Picard/RigidPushforwardRank.lean`), carries a `Module.Projective`
hypothesis which is *load-bearing* (a counterexample is recorded at
`Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Sheaf.lean`:567-576) and which forces `h⁰` to be
locally *constant*.  So that bridge cannot serve semicontinuity; see the
inbox issue filed by `ajc-p4` for the measurement.
